tasks.Exercise: Engaging in physical activity can improve mood and reduce fatigue, making it more enjoyable to continue playing tennis.
tasks.Fatigue: Becoming tired can decrease motivation and enjoyment of the sport.
tasks.Hunger: Feeling hungry might distract from the game, but it does not directly encourage someone to continue playing.
tasks.TennisElbow: Pain from tennis elbow can discourage continued play as it is uncomfortable and may hinder performance.
tasks.Victory: Achieving success or winning matches can provide a sense of accomplishment and motivation to keep playing.
